title: Oxbo Raspberry & Blueberry Harvesters
summary: A promotional video from Oxbo showing its blueberry and raspberry harvesting machines in operation. It demonstrates mechanical berry harvesting at commercial scale.
why: HN cites it as evidence that commercial berry harvesting is done by mechanical shaking and agitation, in contrast to slow picking robots.

quote.text: And the commercial ones that do this entirely by mechanical means.
